'''Glussa Island''' was the largest island of the [[Gluss'elta Archipelago]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]]. The barren rock-stewn island was situated on the western coast of the [[Gluss'elta Sea]] near the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Burning Moon Range]].<ref name="Nal Hutta" /> Around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="Nal Hutta Date">The ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'' states that the [[Numol'elrul]] cut contact with the rest of [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] 5000 thousand [[Standard year|years]] prior. Since the ''Lords of Nal Hutta'' is framed during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]&mdash;which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' the dates from [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]&mdash;this must mean that Numol'elrul broke of contact around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].</ref>  the [[Numol'elrul]], a [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of Kintan's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], cut of all contact with their fellow Nikto and made a home beneath Glussa Island. Over the next five thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the Numol'elrul thrived in isolation as they built a sprawling complex into the island's bedrock. By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Numol'elrul had become only a legend to the rest of Kintan's population which had built several [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]] villages on the island.<ref name="Nal Hutta" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Glussa Island was first mentioned in ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[ Wizards of the Coast]]<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> in [[2004]].<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds Date">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=products/swrpgacc/888870000|text=Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds}}</ref>
